# Version 4.154.0
> **GPU correctness and documented APIs** · Released October 12, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.154.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 brings Skia m154, GPU correctness fixes, and packaged IntelliSense documentation.

## Breaking Changes

- **Use a separate RAW or DNG decoder** — Built-in RAW/DNG development and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement decoder is included. Decode those containers with another library and pass supported pixels or images to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng remains value 10 for compatibility but no longer indicates decoding support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged. ([#5190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5190))
- **Update HarfBuzz enum references** — Rename UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 to CCC132; its numeric value remains 132 and no compatibility alias is provided. Replace GlyphFlags.Defined with a combination of the concrete flags you need. Aggregate BufferFlags.Defined and SerializeFlag.Defined masks are not exposed. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))

## Bug Fixes

- **Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim compatibility** — The bundled libHarfBuzzSharp.dll now passes BA2007 by scoping truncation-warning suppression to vendored source. Existing unrelated BinSkim warnings are unchanged. — ❤️ [@azchohfi](https://github.com/azchohfi) ([#5111](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5111))
- **GPU buffer upload failures** — Ganesh rejects incomplete buffers and drops affected draws when GPU uploads fail under memory pressure, rather than drawing stale contents. Triangulated paths retain CPU vertex data for a later upload attempt. ([#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))
- **Cache cleanup after failed GPU flushes** — Drops uniquely held Ganesh thread-safe cache entries after a failed flush so later draws do not reuse their uninitialized textures. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed. ([#5253](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5253))
- **Atlas tracking and failed GPU work** — Corrects partial glyph-atlas generation tracking and stops dependent image creation, backend-handle extraction, and asynchronous readback after failed prerequisite GPU work. Existing null, false, and invalid-result contracts report failures. ([#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054))

## Engine

- **Skia m154** — Updates the bundled renderer to m154, including Ganesh clipping and Graphite triangle-strip corrections. The native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.2.1 despite the new package revision bucket. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## API Surface

- **HarfBuzz enum coverage** — Synchronizes supported buffer, cluster, glyph, and baseline enum values with bundled HarfBuzz 14.2.1 without adding new managed types. Uno WebAssembly now receives native HarfBuzz assets matching its managed package. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))

## Platform

- **Packaged IntelliSense documentation** — Ships XML documentation beside both implementation and reference assemblies, so consumers receive API help with the assemblies they compile against. Source-authored compiler XML is the final package documentation source. ([#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

Synchronizes supported enum values with bundled HarfBuzz 14.2.1 and supplies compiler XML documentation. Rename CCC133 to CCC132 and replace GlyphFlags.Defined with concrete flags; Windows binaries also pass BA2007.
